svg.title: Metric applicability for all 72 prespecified cases
svg.desc: A 72-row by three-column matrix. Spike-count error is calculated in every case; first-spike latency is calculated in 20 cases and otherwise has no in-window spike; steady-state voltage is calculated in 30 cases, not applicable to protocol in 36, and has insufficient coverage in six.
svg.text: Each row is one case; each cell is a prespecified outcome. Non-evaluable outcomes are not zero.
